verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only programmatic ingestion: insert/insertMultiple in Orama JS, and Orama Cloud 'data sources' as logical groupings of documents. No item mentions an official web crawler or prebuilt connectors that pull content in automatically, so the founder would still need to build their own indexing pipeline. Ingestion tooling is a fair axis for a search engine, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, I can ingest content with an official crawler or connectors instead of writing my own indexing pipeline
